steps.name: Step 1 — Create a skill; its page opens with the Test button visible and enabled
Step 2 — Click Test; panel with input opens
Step 3 — Send message; the skill response is shown
Step 4 — Copy markdown and Copy text icons are visible and enabled
Step 5 — Hover the Copy markdown icon; tooltip 'Copy markdown'
Step 6 — Click Copy markdown; toast 'Markdown copied to clipboard.'
Step 7 — Hover the Copy text icon; tooltip 'Copy text'
Step 8 — Click Copy text; toast 'Text copied to clipboard.'
Cleanup — delete the skill
